title: 201 Years Ago Today, the Boy Banned From Music Became the Waltz King | Strauss

lines: Banned from music, he became the Waltz King.
On this day, October 25.
On this day, October twenty-fifth.
201 years ago today, a boy was born in Vienna.
Two hundred and one years ago today, a boy was born in Vienna.
One day, the whole world would dance to his music.

lines: He was born on October 25, 1825, in Vienna.
He was born on October twenty-fifth, eighteen twenty-five, in Vienna.
His father was a famous musician in Vienna,
but he did not want his son to make music.
He wanted the boy to become a banker.
For a while, he even worked as a bank clerk.
So the boy took violin lessons in secret.
When his father found out, he reportedly whipped him.
But the boy never put down the violin.
In October 1844, at the age of nineteen,
In October eighteen forty-four, at the age of nineteen,
he led his own orchestra for the first time,
at Dommayer's Casino, near Vienna.
He wrote the music, and he conducted it,
and soon all of Vienna knew his name.
On February 15, 1867, in Vienna,
On February fifteenth, eighteen sixty-seven, in Vienna,
his waltz The Blue Danube was played for the first time.
It went on to travel all around the world.
It may be the most famous waltz ever written.
In Austria, it is loved like an unofficial anthem.
In 1872, he was invited to Boston, in the United States.
In eighteen seventy-two, he was invited to Boston, in the United States.
At a huge music festival, the World's Peace Jubilee,

in The Blue Danube.

In his life he wrote about five hundred dance pieces,
and operettas such as Die Fledermaus.
and operettas such as Dee Fleddermouse.

He died in Vienna on June third, eighteen ninety-nine, at seventy-three.

A boy banned from music set the whole world dancing.
